faqs.question: What is the AVANT™ (U)HPLC used for?
faqs.answer: It's a modular HPLC/UHPLC system, used either standalone with UV/UV-Vis detection or integrated with expression CMS for full LC/CMS analysis.

faqs.question: Do I have to choose between standalone and integrated at purchase?
faqs.answer: No, the modular, stackable design supports starting standalone and scaling toward integration later without replacing the core hardware.

faqs.question: What software controls AVANT?
faqs.answer: Mass Express, a dedicated software suite distinct from ClearPeak, which controls Advion Interchim Scientific's separate puriFlash purification line.

faqs.question: How does AVANT fit alongside other expression CMS sample inlets?
faqs.answer: It's one of five confirmed interfaces, alongside Plate Express, ASAP, Touch Express, and vAPCI, all capable of interfacing simultaneously so workflows can switch without reconfiguring the system.

faqs.question: How do I choose between manual and automated UHPLC configuration?
faqs.answer: Match your throughput and budget requirements; the modular design covers everything from simple manual injection HPLC to fully automated UHPLC.

faqs.question: Can AVANT analyze air-sensitive or volatile samples?
faqs.answer: Not directly on its own, but paired with ASAP or vAPCI within the same expression CMS ecosystem, air-sensitive and volatile compound analysis are both confirmed.

faqs.question: What is the relationship between Advion and Interchim?
faqs.answer: Advion Interchim Scientific is the market-facing name of a marketing and distribution partnership between Advion, Inc. (US) and Interchim SAS (France), two separate companies.

faqs.question: Does AVANT support UV/Vis detection without mass spectrometry?
faqs.answer: Yes, standalone operation with UV or UV/Vis detector options is a fully confirmed, independent configuration.

faqs.question: What is the price of the AVANT™ (U)HPLC in India?
faqs.answer: The price depends on your configuration, standalone or integrated, and your modularity level. Contact Inkarp for a quotation once your requirements are confirmed.

faqs.question: Who is the authorized distributor of the AVANT™ (U)HPLC in India?
faqs.answer: Inkarp is the authorized distributor and service provider for the Advion Interchim Scientific AVANT™ (U)HPLC in India, providing demonstration, installation, training, AMC, spare parts, and technical support.

longForm.heroLead: Some labs need a straightforward HPLC with its own detector. Others need full LC/CMS integration. AVANT doesn't force that decision at purchase. Run it standalone with UV or UV/Vis detection, or integrate it directly with expression CMS under Mass Express software for seamless LC/CMS. The modular, stackable design spans from the simplest manual injection HPLC through to a fully automated UHPLC system, configured to your analytical requirements and your budget, not a fixed tier. It's also one of five real sampling interfaces that connect to expression CMS, alongside Plate Express, ASAP, Touch Express, and vAPCI, all of which can interface simultaneously so a chemist moves between workflows without reconfiguring anything.

sections.eyebrow: Standalone HPLC and Integrated LC/CMS Modes
sections.title: Standalone HPLC and Integrated LC/CMS Modes
body: The mode decision doesn't have to happen once and stick forever, since the modular design supports growing into integration later.

Standalone AVANT runs UV or UV/Vis detection directly, a genuine full HPLC or UHPLC system on its own. Integrated with expression CMS, the same platform becomes full LC/CMS, controlled entirely through Mass Express rather than a separate software layer for each half. Because the design is modular and stackable, moving from a simple manual injection setup toward a fully automated UHPLC configuration doesn't mean starting over with new hardware.
